sections.title: Proseminar in Sociological Theory
sections.description: Open to PhD students from all of Penn (excluding first-years, so they focus on their required courses). Faculty from Wharton, Sociology, Annenberg, and History & Sociology of Science who do research relevant to business, organization, and management. Each professor will do a 1.5-hour presentation of a published or unpublished paper of theirs, emphasizing the theoretical framework. Requirements: Class attendance and participation (40%), Two multiple-choice tests (30%), and Final theory paper about hypotheses to guide future empirical research (30%).
